vocabulary.definition: activities done regularly in one's leisure time for pleasure
vocabulary.example: She enjoys painting and playing the guitar as her hobbies.

vocabulary.definition: free time when one is not working and has no obligations
vocabulary.example: During my spare time, I like to read books and watch movies.

vocabulary.definition: feeling calm, comfortable, and free from stress
vocabulary.example: After a long bath, she felt relaxed and ready for bed.

vocabulary.definition: increase or improve something, such as confidence or creativity
vocabulary.example: The workshop helped boost her self-esteem and motivation.

vocabulary.definition: summarize and review the main points
vocabulary.example: Before the exam, the teacher will recap the key topics covered in class.

vocabulary.definition: duties or responsibilities that one is expected to fulfill
vocabulary.example: She had obligations at work that prevented her from attending the event.
